text: For sparse training of a model from a random initialization independent of the initialization used to discover the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis (LTH) mask $\mathfrak{m}_A$, using the permuted mask $\pi(\mathfrak{m}_A)$ yields consistently higher test accuracy than using the non-permuted mask $\mathfrak{m}_A$ across the architectures ResNet20, VGG11, and ResNet50, the datasets CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet, sparsity levels $S\in\{0.80,0.90,0.95,0.97\}$, and rewind points $k$ (the epoch from which weights are reset before sparse training).
